caveats: All metrics are held-out selected-release image metrics; the archive inclusion rule is undocumented, so these do not describe a plate population.
Condition groups with duplicate_group_size > 1 are label-conflict diagnostics, not clean species-specific samples.
The area-fraction prediction/reference relative error uses the same dish radius within each image and cannot measure absolute dish-radius error.
The fitted per-image rim versus block calibration comparison is a sensitivity analysis, not independent ground truth for dish size.
Area-fraction ordering is cross-sectional coverage ordering, not chronology or a same-dish trajectory.

overall.interpretation: The held-out relative area_fraction error reuses the same per-image dish denominator for predicted and reference masks, so that denominator cancels. Its 14.3% SD is therefore segmentation-area error under a fixed denominator. Dish-fit sensitivity is reported separately relative to the block calibration scale; it is not independent ground truth for absolute dish area.
